messages:
alex-g: Hey people-ops — quick Q. Our Eng team merged with Platform last week and we're submitting 3 promotions. Can these be backdated to the team's original effective date (Feb 15)? Need to know for payroll cutoffs and comp reporting.

maria-hr: thx @alex-g for the heads up. short answer: maybe. We need to check pay cycle windows + whether approvals were in place by the retro window.

alex-g: OK. What's considered "retro window"? and what's required to get payback if allowed?

julie-people-ops: Retro window is 30 days from the effective date for payroll to do pay adjustments in the current cycle. After that, changes go into next payroll as adjustments (with possible manual backpay). If effective date is Feb 15 and today is Mar 15, we're at the 28-day mark so likely still ok, but approvals + comp change form must be in by EOD.

priya-payroll: Adding @priya-payroll. For payback we need final approved comp-change form + manager signoff + GL code. Payroll needs the csv by payroll cutoff: see link https://redwood.company/payroll/cutoffs (internal).

priya-payroll: If we miss the cutoff we can do off-cycle payment but that requires Finance signoff and may take 1-2 additional cycles. :grimacing:

ben-smith: To confirm — manager signoff is enough or needs IC + director? Managers can approve promotions up to band X, above that needs director approval. Use the comp-change form to show approval chain.

maria-hr: exact: Manager signoff + compensation committee approval if delta > 15% or passes into next level. Use the template below and reply with the doc link.

maria-hr: ```
Employee,Current Level,Proposed Level,New Base,Adjustment %,Effective Date,Manager,Dir,CompCommittee
J. Doe,IC3,IC4,140000,16,2026-02-15,Alex G,B. Smith,Pending
```

alex-g: got it. i'll fill the template and attach. one more — we have one person who switched teams during the promo window; should effective date be the original team's date or new team's cutover date?

julie-people-ops: Promo effective date should reflect when the manager intended the role change to start. If change is due to an org move, we typically use the date manager approved the promotion. Make a note in the 'reason' field and cc both people ops and payroll.

priya-payroll: also ensure new GL codes are provided for the merged team — otherwise payroll will default to previous cost center and we might need retro reallocation.

alex-g: thanks everyone. i'll upload the csv and tag @maria-hr and @priya-payroll before cutoff (Thu 17:00 PT). :thumbsup:

maria-hr: perfect. if anything blocks, ping in #people-ops and we'll triage. :pray:

payroll-bot: Reminder: payroll cutoff in 48 hours for March cycle — submit comp-change csv via the payroll portal.
